profile_v1_failure.failure: GPU node-4 memory access fault on the first eager M=4 request of the separate fused prefill server

candidate_specific_safety_action.class: folded copy-in lacked a serving-qualified producer-publication contract
candidate_specific_safety_action.reasoning: The folded one-shot path writes producer output into the symmetric buffer from data lanes, then relies on a scalar system-scope release before peer pulls. Single-wave synthetic graph tests passed, but the full serving transition invalidated that proof. Explicit stream-ordered copy-in followed by the existing leading barrier removes that publication dependency. A later unfused graph fault proves this was not the base-runtime root cause.
candidate_specific_safety_action.hardware_evidence: Selected GPUs reported zero ECC, UMC, SDMA, GFX, MMHUB, XGMI-WAFL, and PCIe replay/error counters.

excluded_artifact.reason: An overlapping local pointer diagnostic restarted the shared dedicated container during the first benchmark. The M=4 request itself completed; the client was then terminated. It is retained but excluded.

decision.final_result: Three full transition servers and the three-block/fifteen-pair campaign passed without a safety failure. TP4 promotion remains false because decode TPOT and throughput regressed.
